answer: A relay mesh stays honest when every identity staffs a distinct listening post at its own vertex, each post manned by a different operator who answers a random whisper challenge within seconds. The first identity staffs one post, the tenth ten posts at ten different vertices, and the twentieth twenty, each post relaying a live signal no recording can fake. Twenty invented agents would owe 210 staffed posts. Bulk farming fails because vertices and trained operators are finite, and one person cannot listen at two posts at once, like a whisper that reaches only one ear at a time.
